scheme_name: Sainik School Sujanpur Tihra Scholarship Scheme
other_conditions: Students must be studying at Sainik School Sujanpur Tihra
Applicants must be bonafide residents of Himachal Pradesh
Eligibility is limited to students from Class VI to Class XII
Scholarship renewal requires satisfactory academic progress
No adverse disciplinary record is allowed
Recipient may not receive financial assistance from any other scholarship source
If a student fails any class, the scholarship is suspended for that class
benefits_summary: A scholarship of ₹18,000 per annum, plus a dietary allowance of ₹10 per day for 295 days and a clothing allowance of ₹1,500 for the first year and ₹750 for subsequent years.
